amendment: 01 - native SIP URI and phone resolution
problem_statement: Native SIP can copy an agent route alias into CallAddress.To and then into client.assistant_phone. Exact SIP addresses and phone values need separate, deterministic semantics while preserving the existing CallAddress shape.
verified_context: CallAddress already contains From, To, FromURI, ToURI, and Headers.
SIP core captures complete parsed addresses in FromURI and ToURI.
Inbound pipeline maps CallAddress.From to CallerNumber and CallAddress.To to FromNumber.
The telephony streamer maps CallerNumber to client.phone and FromNumber to client.assistant_phone.
DID route middleware already validates an exact phone option against an active SIP deployment.
Middleware CallAddress enrichment currently requires explicit propagation back through infra and core before session establishment.
acceptance_criteria: CallAddress retains From, To, FromURI, ToURI, and Headers without replacement phone fields.
FromURI and ToURI preserve exact parsed SIP addresses.
From and To contain only values matching ^\+?[0-9]+$ or are empty.
Inbound From comes only from a valid From address user.
Inbound To comes only from a validated DID route or deterministic active SIP deployment selection.
Caller-controlled To headers and custom headers never populate inbound To.
Route-enriched To propagates through infra and core into session and pipeline state.
Outbound SIP aliases remain valid signaling values and produce empty phone fields.
client.phone and client.assistant_phone resolve from direction-aware phone fields only.
No database, protobuf, REST, SDK, UI, or non-SIP provider change is introduced.
non_goals: Rename or mark CallAddress.From or CallAddress.To deprecated.
Use caller-controlled SIP headers as phone sources.
Convert phone values to E.164 or infer country codes.

design.from_uri: Exact parsed From header address and immutable after capture.
design.to_uri: Exact parsed To header address and immutable after capture.
design.from: Trimmed From address user only when it matches ^\+?[0-9]+$; otherwise empty.
design.to_inbound_did: The exact phone option matched by the validated active SIP DID route.
design.to_inbound_agent: The single valid phone option from exactly one active SIP phone deployment for the routed assistant; otherwise empty or rejected according to the RFC.
design.outbound: Authoritative local and remote inputs populate phone fields only when they match the phone grammar; generated URI fields remain exact.
design.metadata: Existing client.phone and client.assistant_phone mappings remain unchanged.

principles.kiss: Reuse the existing CallAddress and call-context metadata path.
principles.yagni: Do not add phone fields, persistence columns, external schemas, UI fields, or trusted-header policy.
principles.single_ownership: SIP core owns capture and parsing, route middleware owns inbound assistant phone resolution, infra owns propagation, and pipeline owns direction mapping.
principles.single_source_of_truth: Tenant-scoped route and active SIP deployment data are the only inbound assistant phone sources.
principles.fail_safe: Unknown phone values remain empty and ambiguous or invalid trusted configuration is rejected.
principles.observability: Emit bounded phone_source and phone_result values without raw URIs or phone values.
principles.least_privilege: Caller-controlled To and custom headers cannot affect authentication phone metadata.
principles.reversibility: Revert the complete implementation as one code-only change; no stored data repair is required.

risks: Changing client.assistant_phone from an agent alias to a phone value changes native SIP authentication payload behavior.
Agent routes without active phone deployment data produce an omitted assistant phone.
Ambiguous deployments must be rejected rather than selected by database order.
Middleware enrichment can be lost unless infra and core propagation are changed together.
Outbound SIP aliases need empty phone metadata without breaking signaling.
Transfer code can leak prior dialog state unless every new leg creates its own snapshot.
required_tests: positive and negative phone grammar cases
inbound To empty before route resolution
agent route missing, valid, invalid, and ambiguous deployment resolution
outbound alias signaling with empty phone fields
transfer, referral, and replacement dialog isolation
rollback: Revert core parsing, route resolution, infra and core propagation, outbound construction, transfer behavior, observability, and tests together. No database rollback or data repair is required.
